purpose: Teach: 帆/ニンニク/アダプタ/槍/ゴマ/えび/復刻/仮面ライダー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが帆船の模型を作られたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to build model sailships.
lines.style: Soft, faraway voice. Gentle opening. Long pause between thoughts. Slow, deliberate pacing—each memory is a small, careful thing being placed down. Warm but distant, like holding something precious from a long time ago.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ニンニク料理がお好きだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and Grandpa really loved cooking with garlic, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, slightly meandering tone. Soft affection in the address. A small smile underneath—she's remembering too, but gently redirecting. Gentle rise and fall, like she's sharing a small secret.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが古いアダプタを取り換えたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was younger, your father would replace old parts without fussing over it.
lines.style: Same wistful register. Quieter attack this time—like he's speaking to himself as much as to her. Slower still. The admiration is there but unspoken, carried in the pause.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お祭りで槍の演武をされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa used to do spear demonstrations at the village festivals, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Bright thread running through her voice now. Still gentle, but there's liveliness in the memory—she can see him doing it. Light touch on the image, like she's painting it for him to see too.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがゴマ和えを得意とされたぞ
lines.en: Gran, in those days, your father was especially good at preparing sesame dishes.
lines.style: Even softer now. Almost a whisper. The pride in his father comes through in the quietness—not boasting, just stating something true that he's carried. Slight catch, like the memory touches something.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、夏になるとえびを楽しまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And every summer, Grandpa would look forward to eating shrimp, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Light and affectionate. There's pleasure in this smaller memory—simpler, almost cozy. Her voice brightens on the small thing. Closing warmth, like she's tucking a memory away safely.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、レコードの復刻を喜ばれたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, he was so pleased whenever records were reissued.
lines.style: Deepest wistfulness here. Almost fragile. The voice opens very softly on the first word. Slow, deliberate. He's giving her something tender—a small joy, a small taste of who his father was.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、孫と一緒に仮面ライダー観てらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa watched Kamen Rider with the grandchildren, remember, dear? He loved that.
lines.style: Warmth breaking through—almost luminous. Lighter pace. The affection is full-bodied now, not holding back. A soft closing, like she's smiling at the image of him laughing with the kids.
